reviews.text: The best grooming salon I've found for a very fluffy and sensitive dog, I recommend it!
Friendly service. Clean premises. Everything went quickly and nicely.
Excellent and attentive service. Anu handles a timid dog with professionalism and warmth! I highly recommend🌸

Anu is wonderful - Halla has been my dog's trusted groomer for three years now. Anu once won the trust of a timid and squinting Bolonka puppy, and I can't imagine taking Halla anywhere else. Anu understands dogs as individuals and Halla is happy to be groomed by her. Of course, the grooming result is also excellent, 10/10 😍. I highly recommend it!
Competent, warm and personalized service. Thank you Julianna for noticing Olaf's anal gland inflammation and a big thank you for your quick response❤️
What a great experience! Lana is definitely the best cat groomer in the city. ✨✨✨
Friendly service - the dog is taken care of very well and the end result is great! Recommended from here, even for more relaxed furry friends👍
Very good trim every time, dog's coat is not the easiest to manage.
With Anu's help, my timid dog can come to get his nails trimmed with complete peace of mind.
Always friendly service and the dog likes it too ❤️

Anna V has done a wonderful job on my two little dogs chihu and Maltese. They were very comfortable with Anna and the grooming was 10/10. I would highly recommend if you are looking for trustable pet groomer
My mini poodle got a very professional poodle trim and the price wasn't bad - I recommend it.
Our dog Hiwa loves this grooming place and is always stylish.

A wonderful and knowledgeable salon. Our toutou, who is not exactly tiny but more of a medium-sized and also a bit of a pushover, has always received a great coat and great dog-friendly treatment here! Grateful for the service, we always come back here again!
Quick but quality. My 🐶 was happy and calm. …

Since opening day, I have been taking both of my Lhasa Apso to Tiny Toutou for regular grooming, bathing, and paw care.
I can confidently leave my boys in the care of these friendly groomers. Highly recommended!
Very friendly service and professional groomers. The atmosphere was nice and relaxed and Elvis was taken care of really well from the start. Highly recommended. <3

The best service! We happened to go here with our first dog right when he was a puppy about 2 years ago, because it was the closest grooming salon to us. Since then, we have been going to the same place as we have been so satisfied.
What is especially wonderful is that they use natural and incredibly effective products for washing.
P.s. we “had” to get these same products ourselves as we were so satisfied and with the results. They even beat the matting of the puppy's coat, which was only about the size of the dog.

I can't help but recommend it very warmly😍
Great service and workmanship. Tiny Toutou has been our trusted place since we were puppies. Thank you for everything Minna 💕 …

Grooming on the dog's terms and a beautiful end result. A trusted place for our miniature poodle. Thank you Emilia! <3
